newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel unit draws up restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel unit draws up restructuring plan.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Friday that its subsidiary Nippon Steel Chemical Co Ltd had drawn up a restructuring programme which included a 40 billion yen third-party share allotment.
Of that amount, Nippon Steel will buy 34.7 billion yen worth of the shares to be issued by Nippon Steel Chemical, it said in a statement. That is equal to 86.875 million shares.

"The chemical sector is an important part of our business and to enable it to grow, we felt that a complete restructuring was vital," it said. "Through the restructuring plan, we will be able to improve profitability and provide stable dividends."
The Nippon Steel subsidiary also said that it posted a net parent loss of 16.21 billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, against a profit of 659 million yen in the previous year.
